race.comment: BARGAIN BOY (3) worked home well but couldn't pick up PRESTIGE ZERPRISE first-up over 1400m on the Parks circuit three weeks ago. Strips fitter and a senior rider goes on today. In a great place to go one better. BLACKJACK (1) made it two wins from his last four when he defeated UPTOWN MONK at Murray Bridge. Getting up in the weights and draws a wide alley but is going too well to rule out. AFFAIRE VUE (9) has been flawless this prep, most recently getting home over this distance at Gawler. Up in grade but drops 3kgs and should give a good account. REGAL RIPPER (6) didn't have the best of luck last time out and is easy to forgive off that effort. He's a track and trip winner and can put his best foot forward.
